title: 水の流れⅠ
subtitle: Hydraulic Engineering I
keywords: Fluid dynamics basics 2.Hydrostatic mechanics 3.Continuous 4.Bernoulli's theorem 5.Steady pipeline flow
educationalGoal: Hydraulics is the foundation of river engineering, coastal engineering, environmental engineering, and water engineering. In this course, learn about hydrostatics and Bernoulli's theorem, which are the foundations of hydraulics
advice: In this course, students will learn the basics of hydrology, hydrostatic mechanics, continuous equations and Bernoulli's theorem. 1. Fluid dynamics basics 2. Hydrostatic mechanics 3. Equation of continuity (mass conservation law) 4. Bernoulli's theorem 5. Loss problems in pipelines
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of physics and mathematics.

activityGoals.body: Understand the physical quantities used in hydraulics
Understand the loss of the pipeline.
